decisions.decision: Fix orphan labels with one global [hidden] { display: none !important } rule
decisions.why: Author display rules outrank the UA hidden rule everywhere; one rule fixes current and future forms

decisions.decision: Effective device action comes from the draft only when the draft is dirty
decisions.why: A clean draft can lag behind the terminal autosave and would show a removed action
decisions.rejected: Draft-first fallback to the saved node

decisions.decision: Row validation also rejects repeated state names
decisions.why: Server validation already rejects them case-insensitively; catching it on the row avoids a generic save failure
decisions.rejected: Leaving it to the server error

decisions.decision: Forced default-state sweep for dialogs the fixture cannot reach naturally
decisions.why: Covers every dialog in index.html instead of marking them NOT RUN
